name: OpenWA
description: Let the owner and people on a WhatsApp number work with one Paperclip agent through a self-hosted OpenWA gateway.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in OpenWA start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.

credentialFields.label: Gateway URL
credentialFields.helperMd: The OpenWA gateway origin. Loopback addresses are allowed for self-hosted gateways.

credentialFields.label: Operator API key
credentialFields.placeholder: OpenWA operator key scoped to one session
credentialFields.helperMd: Create an operator key whose allowedSessions contains only the agent's session and no allowedChats.

credentialFields.label: Admin API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Only needed when gateway admin tools are enabled in Settings.

methods.guidanceMd: Connect a self-hosted OpenWA gateway session. Paperclip inspects the gateway read-only, then asks you to confirm that send pacing is enabled and that Paperclip is the only client sending as the session before an owner sends a test WhatsApp message.
